Remark
[Curvature consequences on noncompact solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0220 ↗ thm:noncompact-two-tensor-maximum-principle ↗ thm:weinberger-hamilton-noncompact-systems 1. ch12:12.52\group Ricci Flow Applications

For complete bounded-curvature Ricci flows on noncompact manifolds, the weak system maximum principles preserve lower scalar-curvature bounds, nonnegative curvature operator, and in dimension three nonnegative Ricci curvature and the Hamilton--Ivey pinching inequality. They likewise preserve nonnegative bisectional curvature under Kähler--Ricci flow.
